text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get back to training camp 
quick!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to say you had fun?
Aren't you going to say you had fun?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That was fun! It was fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't live up to everyone's wish for 
me to win, after all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I have to try even harder and get stronger 
now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I have to... take 1st place! If I do, 
everyone's sure to acknowledge me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because once they acknowledge me, I know 
everyone will smile!

Unlike the early days when she just wanted 
1st place "because it looked fun," Haru 
Urara is different now.

"At last, she is asked for something. 
Simply, to win."
choice_data_list:
Then let's take 1st place in the next 
race!

Then let's take 1st place in the next 
race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to race in a "GⅠ"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
GⅠ races are really important, right? 
That's why I want to win a GⅠ!

Haru Urara spoke up about a race she wants 
to run! It seems she's grown much more 
than I had realized.
choice_data_list:
Then what do you think about the JBC 
Sprint?
Then how about the JBC Sprint?

text_block_list.text:
The distance is short, and it's on a dirt 
course—her specialty. With how she is now, 
Haru Urara has a real chance to take 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm gonna do my best in that race!

And so, it was decided that we'd aim for 
1st place in the next race... the JBC 
Sprint!
